messages:
Maya (Sales): Lyra Finance dropped a SIG + a short questionnaire. Main blockers: BYOK for POC, EU data residency, and SOC2 evidence. Attachments: <https://files.redwood.com/lyra/sig.zip|SIG+QA>
Omar (SE): Quick check: is Lyra planning Dedicated or Private for the trial? That determines BYOK path.
Maya (Sales): They want Dedicated to start but insist on key ownership long-term. Need answers before finalizing trial dates.
security-queue-bot: New intake created: intake_id=INT-2026-0611, priority=high, submitter=Maya (Sales)
Rina (Security Eng): Assigned. I'll triage the SIG and map controls. Short answer: BYOK supported on Private; Dedicated needs infra changes for customer-managed keys. I'll draft gap list + effort estimate by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (RevOps): If engineering work is required, we need a fast-track price. Maya, confirm if buyer will accept a one-time setup fee.
Maya (Sales): Buyer is open to a setup fee if we can guarantee region placement (eu-west-1).
Omar (SE): I'll ask for network diagrams and key lifecycle docs. Template: "Please provide sequence diagram showing ingress, storage, inference, and any KV cache persistence; include key rotation policy." Want me to send it?
Maya (Sales): Yes, send and cc Rina. Emphasize two-week POC timeline.
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0611 status -> triage_in_progress (owner=Rina)
Omar (SE): Sent to lyra-infra@lyra.com. They replied: "Uploading diagrams and key policy by tomorrow."
Rina (Security Eng): Good. I'll prepare three options: 1) Dedicated with provider keys + mitigations, 2) Dedicated + expedited BYOK (if low effort), 3) Private with BYOK. Will include suggested contract clause about key custody.
Sam (RevOps): I'll draft price bands once Rina posts effort estimate.
Maya (Sales): Thanks. Marking opportunity as "Awaiting security intake response" and will update buyer after Rina posts the gaps doc. :thumbsup:
